enbiar: enbiar — to send (infinitive; fizo enbiar por la tienda 'he had (someone) send for the tent'; = enviar)
dexara: dexar — he had left (pluperfect 3rd sg., Latin-type -ra form; la tienda que dexara allá 'the tent he had left behind'; = había dejado)
pesa: pesar — it grieves, it distresses (present 3rd sg., impersonal; mucho pesa a los de Teca 'it greatly grieves the men of Ateca'; = pesa)
plaze: plazer — it pleases (present 3rd sg., impersonal; non plaze 'it does not please, they dislike it'; = place)
calatayuth: Calatayuth — Calatayud, town in Zaragoza province (th is a spelling of final -d)
pesando: pesar — grieving, distressed (gerund; pesando va 'goes on grieving'; = pesando)
valençia: Valençia — Valencia, the Moorish kingdom and city whose king Tamín is addressed (= Valencia)
enbiaron: enbiar — they sent (preterite 3rd pl.; al rey de Valençia enbiaron con mensaje 'they sent to the king of Valencia with a message'; = enviaron)
mensaje: mensaje — message, messenger's errand (con mensaje 'with a message'; = mensaje)
dizien: dezir — they called, said (imperfect 3rd pl., -ié ending; a uno que dizien mio Çid 'one whom they called my Cid'; = decían)
ayrólo: airar + lo — he was angry at him, banished him in anger (airó, preterite 3rd sg., + enclitic lo; ayrólo rey Alfonsso 'King Alfonso, angered, banished him'; = lo airó)
sacólos: sacar + los — he drew them out, lured them (sacó, preterite 3rd sg., + enclitic los; sacólos a çelada 'he lured them into an ambush'; = los sacó)
ganado: ganar — captured, won (past part.; el castiello ganado a 'he has taken the castle', aver + participle; = ganado)
das: dar — you give (present 2nd sg.; si non das consejo 'if you do not give counsel'; = das)
perderás: perder — you will lose (future 2nd sg.; = perderás)
ribera: ribera — riverbank, river valley (ribera de Salón 'the valley of the Jalón'; = ribera)
irá: ir — it will go (future 3rd sg.; irá a mal 'will go to ruin'; = irá)
ferá: fazer — it will do, will fare (syncopated future 3rd sg. of fazer; assí ferá lo de Siloca 'so too will it be with the Siloca (country)'; = hará)
siloca: Siloca — the river Jiloca (tributary of the Jalón) and its valley; lo de Siloca 'what is of the Jiloca' (= Jiloca)
otra: otro — other (fem. sg.; del otra part 'on the other side', with el before a vowel-initial feminine noun, = de la otra parte)
odió: oír — he heard (preterite 3rd sg., Latin audivit; quando lo odió rey Tamín 'when King Tamín heard it'; = oyó)
tamín: Tamín — the Moorish 'king of Valencia' who sends the army; invented by the poet (Pidal: no king Tamín of Valencia ever existed); the name is perhaps Arabic Tamīm
pesó: pesar — it grieved (preterite 3rd sg., impersonal; por cuer le pesó mal 'it grieved him sorely at heart'; = pesó)
estar: estar — to stand, be (infinitive after veer; tres reyes veo … derredor de mí estar 'I see three kings standing about me'; = estar)
detardedes: detardar — you delay (present subjunctive 2nd pl., -edes; non lo detardedes 'do not delay it', prohibition; = tardéis, retraséis)
levedes: levar — you take, carry (2nd pl., -edes; here a command, tres mill moros levedes 'take three thousand Moors'; probably present subjunctive used as imperative; = llevad)
armas: arma — weapon, arms (pl.; armas de lidiar 'weapons for fighting'; en armas 'in arms, armed'; = armas)
frontera: frontera — frontier, border region; los de la frontera 'the frontier garrisons, the men of the border' (= frontera)
ayudarán: ayudar — they will help (future 3rd pl.; = ayudarán)
prendétmelo: prender + me + lo — seize him for me (prended + me + lo, imperative 2nd pl. with enclitics, d assimilated to t; prendétmelo a vida 'take him for me alive'; = prendedmelo)
aduzidmelo: aduzir + me + lo — bring him to me (aduzid + me + lo, imperative 2nd pl. with enclitics; aduzidmelo delant 'bring him before me'; = traédmelo)
derecho: derecho — right, justice; satisfaction owed (noun; derecho me avrá a dar 'he will have to give me redress'; = derecho)
avrá: aver — he will have (future 3rd sg., syncopated; aver a + inf. 'will have to': me avrá a dar 'he will have to give me'; = habrá)
mil: mil — thousand (variant of mill; tres mil moros 'three thousand Moors'; = mil)
sogorve: Sogorve — Segorbe, town north of Valencia (Castellón province; = Segorbe)
çelfa: Çelfa — Cella (Teruel), place on the road to Calatayud; Çelfa de Canal, see canal (= Cella)
enviar: enviar — to send (infinitive; pienssan de enviar 'they set about sending'; = enviar)
detienen: detener — they delay, hold back (present 3rd pl.; non lo detienen 'they do not delay it'; = detienen)
canal: Canal — part of the name of Çelfa (Cella): Çelfa la que dizen de Canal 'Çelfa, the one they call of the Canal'; what Canal refers to is uncertain (Pidal does not explain it)
ajuntaron: ajuntar — they gathered, assembled (preterite 3rd pl.; gentes se ajuntaron 'folk gathered'; = juntaron)
sobejanas: sobejano — excessive, huge, overwhelming (fem. pl.; gentes sobejanas 'enormous hosts'; = sobrada, enorme)
aquestos: aqueste — these (masc. pl., 'aqueste' = este with prefixed aque-; aquestos dos reyes 'these two kings'; = estos)
fáriz: Fáriz — a Moorish 'king', commander with Galve of the army sent against the Çid; fictional, says Pidal (the name perhaps Arabic Fāris)
galve: Galve — a Moorish 'king', commander with Fáriz of the army sent against the Çid; fictional, says Pidal
çercar: çercar — to besiege, surround (infinitive; le van çercar 'they go to besiege him', ir + infinitive; = cercar)
fincaron: fincar — they planted, pitched (preterite 3rd pl.; fincaron las tiendas 'they pitched the tents'; = hincaron, plantaron)
prendend: prender — they take up (present 3rd pl.; prendend las posadas 'they take up quarters'; the final -d is probably an unetymological spelling, = prenden)
creçen: creçer — they grow, increase (present 3rd pl.; = crecen)
virtos: virtos — uncertain word, probably 'forces, hosts' (pl.; creçen estos virtos 'these forces grow'; perhaps from Latin virtus; the exact sense is doubtful)
arrobdas: arrobda — sentry, watch, patrol (pl.; las arrobdas que los moros sacan 'the watches the Moors post'; = rondas, centinelas)
sacan: sacar — they put out, post (present 3rd pl.; las arrobdas … sacan 'the patrols they send out'; = sacan)
enbueltos: enbuelto — wrapped, clad (past part. masc. pl.; enbueltos en armas 'clad in arms'; = envueltos)
muchas: mucho — many (fem. pl.; muchas son las arrobdas 'many are the watches'; = muchas)
almofalla: almofalla — encampment, host, army camp (Arabic al-maḥalla; = hueste, campamento)
tuellen: toller — they take away, cut off (present 3rd pl.; les tuellen el agua 'they cut off their water'; = quitan)
batalla: batalla — battle (= batalla; exir a batalla 'to sally out to battle')
vedava: vedar — he forbade (imperfect 3rd sg.; firme gelo vedava 'he firmly forbade it to them'; = vedaba, prohibía)
toviérongela: tener + ge + la — they held it in siege on him (tovieron, strong preterite 3rd pl., + ge = le, the Çid, + la, the referent loose — probably the town or the siege; toviérongela en çerca 'they kept him besieged'; = se la tuvieron)
quarta: quarto — fourth (fem.; la quarta sedmana 'the fourth week'; = cuarta)
queríe: querer — it was about to (imperfect 3rd sg., -íe spelling of -ié; la quarta queríe entrar 'the fourth (week) was about to begin'; = quería)
acordar: acordar — to take counsel, agree (infinitive; tornós a acordar 'he set to take counsel'; = acordar)
queramos: querer — we may wish (present subjunctive 1st pl.; que nos queramos ir 'if we should want to go', que + subjunctive as a condition; = queramos)
consintrán: consentir — they will allow (future 3rd pl.; no nos lo consintrán 'they will not allow us it'; = consentirán)
poderes: poder — power, forces, strength (noun, pl.; grandes son los poderes 'great are the forces'; = poderes)
dezidme: dezir + me — tell me (dezid, imperative 2nd pl., + me; = decidme)
prestar: prestar — to be worth, avail (infinitive; cavallero de prestar 'a knight of worth'; = valer)
gentil: gentil — noble, fair, excellent (Castiella la gentil 'noble Castile'; = gentil)
acá: acá — here, hither (adverb; exidos somos acá 'we have come out to here'; = acá)
lidiáremos: lidiar — (if) we fight (future subjunctive 1st pl., -re; si con moros non lidiáremos 'if we do not fight the Moors'; = lidiemos, archaic lidiáremos)
ay: aver — there is, there are (impersonal, present of aver, with y 'there' attached; algunos ay de más 'there are some more besides'; = hay)
passe: passar — it may pass, may go (present subjunctive 3rd sg.; que non passe por al 'let it not pass by other means, let it be done so'; = pase)
vayámoslos: ir + los — let us go at them (vayamos, present subjunctive 1st pl. hortative, + enclitic los; = vayámoslos)
ferir: ferir — to strike, attack (infinitive; vayámoslos ferir 'let us go and strike them'; = herir)
ondrástesvos: ondrar + vos — you have honoured yourself (ondrastes, preterite 2nd pl., the polite vos to Minaya alone, + reflexive vos; = os honrasteis)
iedes: aver — you would (conditional ending 2nd pl., -iedes, split from its infinitive aver: aver vos lo iedes de far = os lo habríais de hacer, 'you would be bound to do it'; Pidal: far stands for ondrar, 'for you were sure to honour yourself')
manda: mandar — he orders (present 3rd sg.; manda echar 'orders (them) put out'; = manda)
echar: echar — to cast out, put out (infinitive; los manda echar 'orders them put out'; = echar)
piénssanse: pensar + se — they set about (present 3rd pl. + reflexive; piénssanse de adobar 'they set about getting ready'; = se ponen a)
adobar: adobar — to equip, make ready (infinitive; = adobar, aderezar)
querie: querer — it was about to (imperfect 3rd sg., unaccented spelling of querié; el sol querie apuntar 'the sun was about to rise'; = quería)
apuntar: apuntar — to begin to show, to dawn (infinitive; el sol querie apuntar 'the sun was about to rise'; = apuntar, asomar)
armado: armar — armed (past part.; armado es mio Çid 'my Cid is armed', ser as auxiliary; = armado)
contar: contar — to tell, recount (infinitive; commo odredes contar 'as you will hear told'; = contar)
iscamos: exir — let us go out (present subjunctive 1st pl., hortative; todos iscamos fuera 'let us all go out'; = salgamos)
raste: rastar — may remain, stay behind (present subjunctive 3rd sg.; que nadi non raste 'that no one stay behind'; probably from Latin restare; = quede)
pedones: pedón — foot-soldier (pl.; the old form of peón, Latin pedonem; dos pedones solos 'only two foot-soldiers'; = peones)
solos: solo — alone, only (masc. pl.; dos pedones solos 'only two foot-soldiers'; = solos)
guardar: guardar — to guard (infinitive; por la puerta guardar 'to guard the gate'; = guardar)
muriéremos: morir — (if) we die (future subjunctive 1st pl., -re; si nos muriéremos en campo 'if we die in the field'; = muramos, archaic muriéremos)
entrarán: entrar — they will enter (future 3rd pl.; en castiello nos entrarán 'they will enter the castle for us/against us'; = entrarán)
vençiéremos: vençer — (if) we win (future subjunctive 1st pl., -re; si vençiéremos la batalla 'if we win the battle'; = venzamos, archaic venciéremos)
creçremos: creçer — we shall grow (syncopated future 1st pl.; creçremos en rictad 'we shall grow in wealth'; = creceremos)
rictad: rictad — wealth, riches (Pidal 'riqueza'; creçremos en rictad 'we shall grow in wealth'; = riqueza)
tomad: tomar — take! (imperative 2nd pl.; la mi seña tomad 'take my banner'; = tomad)
tener: tener — to hold, keep (infinitive, first element of the split future tener la edes 'you will hold it'; = tener)
edes: aver — you (will) have (2nd pl. of aver, -edes ending; second element of the split future tener la edes 'you will hold it'; = tendréis)
arth: art — guile, deceit (arth, a spelling of art; Pidal 'mal arte, engaño'; sin art 'loyally, without guile'; = arte, engaño)
aguijedes: aguijar — you spur, hasten (present subjunctive 2nd pl., -edes; non aguijedes 'do not spur on, do not charge'; = aguijéis)
mandar: mandar — to command (infinitive); in si yo non vos lo mandar future subjunctive 1st sg. (= mandare, 'unless I order you'; = mande)
besó: besar — he kissed (preterite 3rd sg.; al Çid besó la mano 'he kissed the Cid's hand'; = besó)
viéronlo: veer + lo — they saw it (vieron, strong preterite 3rd pl., + enclitic lo; = lo vieron)
tornáronse: tornar + se — they turned, set (to) (tornaron, preterite 3rd pl., + reflexive se; tornáronse a armar 'they set to arming themselves again'; = se volvieron)
armar: armar — to arm (infinitive; tornáronse a armar 'they set about arming'; = armar)
roído: roído — noise, din (= ruido; ante roído de atamores 'at the din of drums')
atamores: atamor — drum (pl.; also atambor, from Arabic, with the article al- assimilated; ante roído de atamores 'at the din of the drums'; = tambores)
quebrar: quebrar — to break, shatter (infinitive; la tierra querié quebrar 'the ground was about to split'; = quebrar)
armarse: armar + se — to arm oneself (infinitive + reflexive; veriedes armarse moros 'you would see Moors arming'; = armarse)
az: az — battle line, rank, battalion (Latin acies; entrar en az 'to fall into line'; = hilera, escuadrón)
parte: parte — part, side (de parte de los moros 'on the Moors' side'; = parte)
cabdales: cabdal — chief, principal (pl.; dos señas cabdales 'two chief banners'; = principales)
mezclados: mezclar — mixed, jumbled (past part. masc. pl.; los pendones mezclados 'the pennons intermingled'; = mezclados)
podrié: poder — he could (conditional 3rd sg., -ié ending; ¿qui los podrié contar? 'who could count them?'; = podría)
azes: az — battle lines, ranks (pl.; las azes de los moros 'the Moorish battalions'; = hileras, escuadrones)
yas: ya + se — already … themselves (ya + reflexive se cut to s; yas mueven 'they are already moving'; = ya se)
mueven: mover — they move, advance (present 3rd pl.; yas mueven adelant 'already they move forward'; = mueven)
quedas: quedo — quiet, still (adj. fem. pl.; quedas seed 'stay still'; = quedas, quietas)
derranche: derranchar — may break rank, dash out (present subjunctive 3rd sg.; non derranche ninguno 'let no one break out'; probably = rompa filas)
mande: mandar — I command, I order (present subjunctive 1st sg.; fata que yo lo mande 'until I order it'; = mande)
endurar: endurar — to endure, bear, hold back (infinitive; non lo pudo endurar 'could not bear it'; = aguantar)
conpeçó: començar — he began (preterite 3rd sg.; conpeçó de espolonar 'he began to spur'; = comenzó)
meter: meter — to put, set (infinitive; vo meter la vuestra seña 'I go to put your banner'; = meter)
aquella: aquel — that (fem. sg.; aquella mayor az 'that largest battle line'; = aquella)
mayor: mayor — larger, greater (aquella mayor az 'that greatest line'; = mayor)
acorrades: acorrer — you help (present subjunctive 2nd pl., -ades; commo la acorrades 'how you succour it, i.e. the banner'; = acorráis, socorráis)
caridad: caridad — charity, mercy; por caridad 'for charity's sake, I beg you' (= caridad)
rastará: rastar — it will remain (future 3rd sg.; non rastará por al 'it shall not be otherwise', Pidal 'no quedará de otro modo'; = quedará)
espolonó: espolonar — he spurred (preterite 3rd sg.; espolonó el cavallo 'he spurred the horse'; = espoleó)
metiól: meter + l — he drove, set (him) (metió, preterite 3rd sg., + elided enclitic l(o), probably the horse; metiól en el mayor az 'he drove it into the largest line'; = lo metió)
danle: dar + le — they give him (dan, present 3rd pl., + enclitic le; danle grandes colpes 'they deal him great blows'; = le dan)
falssar: falssar — to pierce, break through (armour, shield) (infinitive; nol pueden falssar 'they cannot pierce him'; = falsear, quebrantar)
valelde: valer + le — help him (valed, imperative 2nd pl., + enclitic le, with d and l transposed; = valedle, ayudadle)

__broaden__.van: ir — they go (present 3rd pl.) · also ir + gerund 'keep going' (passando van 'they go on passing') · also ir + infinitive 'go to' (le van çercar 'they go to besiege him'; se van tornar 'they go back')
__broaden__.va: ir — he/she goes (present 3rd sg.; = va); ir + gerund, 'to be (gradually) doing' · ir + infinitive 'goes to' (la manol va besar 'goes to kiss his hand', el Duero va passar 'goes to cross the Duero') · also va — 'there is, goes on' impersonal (¡Qué priessa va en los moros! 'what a stir there is among the Moors!')
__broaden__.mal: mal — harm, hurt, ruin · mal — evil, in the prayer's sense (por end es salvo de mal 'therefore he is saved from evil') · also mal — adverb 'sorely, ill' (por cuer le pesó mal 'it grieved him sorely at heart')
__broaden__.la: el/la — the (fem.); her/it (object pronoun) · also la que 'the one that' (Çelfa la que dizen de Canal 'Çelfa, the one they call of the Canal')
__broaden__.señas: señas — one each, one apiece (distributive adjective, fem. pl., Latin singulas; = sendas) · also seña — banner, standard (pl.; dos señas ha cabdales 'there are two chief banners')
__broaden__.l: le — to him (elided before vowel: l'an = le han) · also 'l = el, the article cut after a vowel (todo 'l día 'all the day')
__broaden__.consejo: consejo — counsel, advice · also consejo — help, remedy (si non das consejo 'if you give no help'; Pidal 'si no nos das ayuda')
__broaden__.pregones: pregón — public proclamation, crier's announcement (pl.; = pregones) · also pregón — crier, herald (Pidal: in the sense of Latin praeconem; los pregones dan 'they send out the criers', 'despachan pregoneros')
__broaden__.ante: ante — before; ante que 'before (that)' · also ante — because of, at (of the cause, like Latin prae; ante roído de atamores 'at the din of the drums')
__broaden__.qui: qui — he who, whoever (old relative pronoun, Latin qui; = quien) · also qui — who? (interrogative; ¿qui los podrié contar? 'who could count them?'; = quién)
__broaden__.part: part — share, portion (noun; = parte) · also part — side (del otra part 'on the other side'; = parte)
__broaden__.çerca: çerca — near; here adverbial, çerca o tarde = 'sooner or later' (= cerca) · also çerca — siege, encirclement (noun; en çerca 'under siege'; = cerco)
__broaden__.aver: aver — wealth, property, goods (noun use of aver, beside aver the verb 'to have') · also aver — to have (infinitive; aver … de + inf. 'to be bound to', split conditional aver vos lo iedes de far 'you would be bound to do it')
__broaden__.ha: aver — he has (3rd sg. present; = ha) · ha — to (a with h-, aver a + inf. 'will, must': lo an todos ha far 'all are to do it'); aver — has, possesses (las fijas que ha 'the daughters she has') · also ha — future ending after infinitive + clitics, the split future (tornar nos la ha 'he will give it back to us'; = nos la tornará) · also ha — there is, there are (impersonal; dos señas ha cabdales 'there are two chief banners'; = hay)
__broaden__.aquel: aquel — that one, whoever · also aquel — that (demonstrative adjective; aquel día de cras 'tomorrow'; aquella mayor az 'that biggest line')
